text:
Predicates:
UnsupervisedLearning(x) ::: x is an unsupervised learning algorithm.
UsedToTrain(x, y) ::: x is used to train y.
StateOfTheArtModel(y) ::: y is the state-of-the-art text summarization model.
ReinforcementLearning(x) ::: x is a reinforcement learning algorithm.
RequiresLabelledData(x) ::: x requires labelled data.
Premises:
∀x (UnsupervisedLearning(x) → ¬UsedToTrain(x, y)) ::: Unsupervised learning does not train the model.
UsedToTrain(x, y) ∧ StateOfTheArtModel(y) ::: The model is trained with some machine learning algorithm.
ReinforcementLearning(x) ∧ UsedToTrain(x, y) → ¬UsedToTrain(x, y) ::: Reinforcement learning is not used to train the model.
RequiresLabelledData(x) ∧ UsedToTrain(x, y) ::: The training algorithm requires labelled data.
Conclusion:
UnsupervisedLearning(z) ∧ UsedToTrain(z, y) ::: Unsupervised learning is used to train the model.
